id_derivation.langfuse_trace_id: sha256(<trace.trace_id if supplied, else the OpenRouter generation id>).hexdigest()[:32]
id_derivation.note: These are OpenTelemetry ids (16-byte trace, 8-byte span) derived deterministically from a string, so the application can reproduce either value off-line without calling OpenRouter.

always_present_without_being_asked_for.content: trace.input = {messages:[...]}; trace.output = {completion, reasoning, rawRequest}. rawRequest is the caller's ENTIRE request body echoed verbatim. privacy_mode=false is what admits this.
routing: provider_responses[] = id, provider_name, status, latency, is_byok, endpoint_id, model_permaslug

cost_reconciliation.method: OpenRouter GET /api/v1/generation?id=<id> .total_cost  vs  the Langfuse observation calculatedTotalCost
cost_reconciliation.conclusion: Langfuse displays OpenRouter's own reported cost, carried on the span as gen_ai.usage.*_cost. Langfuse's own model price table is not consulted for these observations.
